categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and changes connection management and transaction broadcast state in src/private_broadcast.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents adversaries from deanonymizing private broadcasts via a timing side channel that canceled remaining outbound connections if a transaction returned early. The p2p definition prioritizes resistance to attack and privacy of transaction origin, and leaving this privacy-compromising side channel unaddressed across releases undermines private broadcast security.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Test modifications are domain-specific tests for private broadcast and a mechanical one-line addition to test_runner.py, not changes to test framework infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Does not touch testing machinery or framework capabilities; area-specific tests belong to P2P.
